name: Text Generation Workflow
description: Generate natural language text responses (summary, explanation, etc.)
explanation:
This workflow demonstrates how to generate natural language text using the TEXT output mode.

Key features:
- outputFormat: "text" instead of "json"
- No JSON Schema required - AI returns free-form text
- gpt-6-luna: reasoning-capable model (temperature/top_p are not used by this model family)
- Simple 3-node structure: Start → AI → End

Use cases:
- Summarizing documents or articles
- Generating explanations or descriptions
- Creating conversational responses
- Writing content drafts

The systemMessage guides the AI's writing style and format.
